transcript.thinking_modal_hint: Click the thinking title inside the session to open the full content here again.
transcript.thinking_overlay_hint: Streaming thinking stays here first and then folds back into the main session after completion.
transcript.input_hint: After you enter a task and start execution, this session's output will appear here.
transcript.no_api_request_snapshot: There is no real API request snapshot yet.
transcript.no_renderable_blocks: There are currently no renderable unified output blocks.

transcript.audio_preview_hint: Click the play button below to play this audio. Click again to stop.
transcript.video_preview_hint: You can open this video with the system player or reveal it in the file manager.
transcript.document_preview_hint: This document can be opened directly or revealed in the file manager.

transcript.subagent_failed_hint: The subagent failed and only the failure summary is currently retained.

transcript.subagent_running_hint: The subagent is still running. The full transcript will appear after it finishes.
transcript.subagent_stopped_hint: The subagent has stopped. The current context, thinking, and output fragments are kept as they were at stop time.
transcript.tool_modal_hint: This view shows the full tool arguments, result payload, and any host-generated media.
